fidelityBoundary: Terminal Velocity automation/design scaffold; not an EV Classic fidelity claim without original runtime, decoded Classic resources, or manual/docs confirmation.

levo_merchant_first_hop.purpose: Merchant first-hop loop: buy a Levo commodity lot, accept a safe cargo job, jump, land, and complete delivery.

levo_same_port_sellback_loop.purpose: Source-backed Levo trade loop: buy one observed 10-ton Food lot, sell it back at the same port, and verify credits/cargo return to the starting state.

cross_market_trade_spread_scout.purpose: Cross-market trade spread scout: travel to Sol, buy a lower-priced Food lot, return to Levo, and sell against the active Terminal Velocity market spread while retaining explicit pending-Classic source boundaries.

max_hold_trade_route_scout.purpose: Max-hold trade-route scout: fill the starting 20-ton hold with two Sol Food lots, return to Levo, sell both lots, and verify profit while retaining explicit pending-Classic multi-lot economy boundaries.

trade_route_refuel_profit_loop.purpose: Trade-route refuel recovery loop: fill the starting hold at Sol, block the return profit leg on empty fuel, refuel at Earth, then return to Levo and sell both lots while retaining explicit pending-Classic fuel/trade boundaries.

mission_runner_first_delivery.purpose: Mission-runner loop: reserve cargo, travel to destination, complete job, release reserved cargo, and receive pay.

route_planner_refuel_loop.purpose: Route-planner loop: spend fuel on a jump, detect insufficient fuel as a blocker, and refuel while landed.

low_fuel_jump_recovery.purpose: Low-fuel recovery loop: force empty fuel, block a route jump without changing systems, and refuel at the current landed port.

blocked_reason_curriculum.purpose: Safe blocker recognition: not landed, insufficient cargo, insufficient credits, invalid destination, and no deliverable job.

contraband_scan_clemency_recovery.purpose: Contraband scan/recovery loop: confiscate illegal cargo, apply a government fine/legal penalty, then pay a clemency scaffold to partially repair the legal record while preserving source boundaries.

pirate_avoidance_escape_route.purpose: Pirate-avoidance loop: detect a symbolic pirate intercept, choose a linked safe-port jump, land, and verify combat remains unexecuted while preserving scaffold/source-boundary labels.

disposable_combat_placeholder.purpose: Combat/piracy guardrail scaffold only; records stop conditions without executing destructive tests.

intro_courier_mission_delivery.purpose: Intro courier mission loop: travel from Levo to Earth, accept the first courier mission, reserve mission cargo, travel to Luna, complete delivery, release cargo, receive reward, and apply story flags.

scan_intro_mission_offers.purpose: Mission-offer scan loop: travel to Earth, inspect landed mission offers by surface, and archive available mission ids before accepting a contract.

chapter_one_courier_chain.purpose: Chapter-one courier chain: complete the intro courier, frontier sample transfer, and return contract in one deterministic noncombat story loop.

alignment_choice_guardrail.purpose: Alignment branch guardrail: accept one mutually exclusive faction branch, then verify the incompatible branch is unavailable without mutating cargo or completing combat.

alignment_offer_requirement_recovery.purpose: Alignment offer requirement recovery: at Sirius Station, verify both chapter-one branch offers are hidden just below their reputation/legal thresholds, then reappear at the manifest thresholds while preserving pending-Classic UI boundaries.
alignment_offer_requirement_recovery.surface: mission availability/reputation and legal gate scaffold

federation_alignment_delivery_loop.purpose: Federation alignment delivery loop: accept the Federation branch, deliver its report to Earth, preserve branch/completion flags, and verify the incompatible Freeport branch stays blocked afterward.

freeport_alignment_delivery_loop.purpose: Freeport alignment delivery loop: accept the Freeport branch, deliver its pact cargo to Luna, preserve branch/completion flags, and verify the incompatible Federation branch stays blocked afterward.

shift_click_multi_stop_route_queue.purpose: Map route-planner loop: Shift-click linked stops to build a green multi-hop route queue, then consume only the first leg on jump.

route_queue_invalid_stop_guardrail.purpose: Map route guardrail loop: preserve the current green route queue when a duplicate/current-system or unlinked stop is attempted from the route tail.
route_queue_invalid_stop_guardrail.surface: map route planning/Terminal Velocity guardrail scaffold

route_queue_clear_guardrail.purpose: Map route guardrail loop: clear a queued multi-stop route explicitly, then block jump until another destination is selected.
route_queue_clear_guardrail.surface: map route planning/Terminal Velocity guardrail scaffold

route_queue_clear_reselect_guardrail.purpose: Map route guardrail loop: after clearing a queued multi-stop route, accept a fresh route selection and jump only after that re-selection.
route_queue_clear_reselect_guardrail.surface: map route planning/Terminal Velocity guardrail scaffold

near_center_jump_block.purpose: Hyperspace distance guardrail: block a queued route jump while still near the system center, preserve system/fuel state, and label the behavior from original-runtime near-center failure evidence while exact distance remains pending.

mission_destination_route_hint.purpose: Mission objective route hint: after accepting an active courier contract, queue the contract destination as the next map route leg.
mission_destination_route_hint.surface: mission objective/map route guidance design scaffold

mission_trade_hybrid_capacity_planning.purpose: Mission-trader hybrid loop: accept an 8-ton courier job, use the remaining capacity for one commodity lot, block a second lot for capacity, then complete the mission while retaining trade cargo.

mission_trade_refuel_delivery_loop.purpose: Mission/trade/refuel loop: accept an intro courier at Earth, carry one commodity lot in remaining hold space, block the delivery jump on empty fuel, refuel, then deliver while retaining trade cargo under explicit pending-Classic boundaries.

mission_trade_destination_sale_loop.purpose: Mission/trade destination-sale loop: accept an intro courier at Earth, carry one Sol Food lot in remaining hold space, deliver at Luna, then sell the trade lot at the destination-system market while preserving pending-Classic economy boundaries.

chapter_one_trade_carryover_loop.purpose: Chapter-one trade-carryover loop: carry a Sol Food lot through two noncombat story deliveries, reserve mission cargo alongside held trade cargo, then sell the lot at Sirius Station while preserving pending-Classic economy/story-chain boundaries.
chapter_one_trade_carryover_loop.surface: multi-mission story progression / mission-trade carryover scaffold

mission_trade_return_margin_guardrail.purpose: Chapter-one return margin guardrail: after selling carried cargo at Sirius Station, evaluate an unprofitable return cargo candidate, skip it, then finish the return courier contract with explicit pending-Classic economy/story-chain boundaries.
mission_trade_return_margin_guardrail.surface: multi-mission story progression / trade-margin decision scaffold

mission_abort_releases_reserved_cargo.purpose: Mission abort scaffold: abort an active courier contract without completion, release its reserved cargo, and keep source/oracle boundaries explicit pending Classic confirmation.

mission_abort_reaccept_delivery_loop.purpose: Mission abort/reaccept recovery scaffold: accept the intro courier, abort and release its reserved cargo, reaccept the same Terminal Velocity scaffold mission, deliver it, and retain abort history while keeping Classic behavior confirmation pending.

mission_deadline_failure_scaffold.purpose: Mission deadline/failure scaffold: accept a timed delivery, advance past the limit, release reserved cargo, set a failure flag, and apply the EV Classic Resource Bible-backed half-CompReward reputation penalty while retaining runtime-UI confirmation as pending.

outfitter_ship_ladder_intro.purpose: Outfitter/ship-ladder intro: reach Earth, buy a cargo upgrade and weapon, then trade up to a larger ship from local manifest stock while preserving explicit scaffold/source-boundary labels.

repair_service_recovery_loop.purpose: Repair-service recovery loop: damage hull, verify repair blocks in space and at a no-repair port, then repair at a service port using the manifest price-per-hull-point while preserving explicit Classic-runtime-pending labels.

disabled_player_recovery_loop.purpose: Disabled-player recovery loop: force the player ship disabled, verify movement/combat/mission actions block behind the disabled state, then recover through the Terminal Velocity F8 scaffold while preserving Classic death/reload evidence boundaries.

system_service_provisioning_scout.purpose: System-service scouting loop: record Levo's original-runtime-observed absence of outfitter/shipyard, then compare Earth and Stardock Alpha service/store matrices as Terminal Velocity provisioning scaffolds pending Classic confirmation.

commodity_sell_blocked_recovery_loop.purpose: Commodity sell guardrail/recovery loop: block selling a lot when no cargo is held, buy a Levo lot, block selling while in space, then land and sell to restore starting credits/cargo while preserving Terminal Velocity scaffold/source-boundary labels.

commodity_buy_blocked_recovery_loop.purpose: Commodity buy guardrail/recovery loop: block buying while in space, without credits, and without capacity, then recover by landing and buying one Levo lot while preserving Terminal Velocity scaffold/source-boundary labels.
